run_branching: run branch-and-bound to find a tight upper bound for a neural network
run_batched_branching: run batched branch-and-bound to evaluate multiple subdomains simultaneously for faster bounding
upper_bound_with_branching: compute an upper bound on a specification function using repeated bound propagation with branching
evaluate_branch: evaluate a branch by computing intermediate bounds and selecting the highest-score neuron to split
BranchQueue: manage a priority queue of branch leaves for branch-and-bound minimization
